# Microsoft Entra Agent ID: a pinned copy of Learn's samples

This folder is an unmodified copy of three Microsoft Learn source pages: [Create an agent identity blueprint](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/agent-id/create-blueprint), [Configure inheritable permissions for agent identity blueprints](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/agent-id/configure-inheritable-permissions-blueprints) and [Disable agent identities in your tenant](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/agent-id/disable-agent-identities). They hold Microsoft's HTTP samples for creating a blueprint with a sponsor and an owner, adding a managed identity as the blueprint's federated identity credential, adding a password, configuring inheritable permissions, and the Microsoft Graph bodies of the three agent Conditional Access policies. They come from [MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs](https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs/tree/7f78b50dce9d8cf119de57cbd6fd66e24a6c58d4/docs/agent-id) at commit `7f78b50dce9d8cf119de57cbd6fd66e24a6c58d4` (October 30, 2026). The repository's code license (`LICENSE-CODE`) and documentation license (`LICENSE`) are both MIT.

**Why the pages, not just the samples.** The samples exist only inside these pages. Pinning the pages byte for byte keeps the copy checkable against upstream. `examples/non-person-identity/tests/AgentIdSampleHarness.ps1` parses the HTTP samples, unmodified, at test time and sends them to the chapter's fake Microsoft Graph. Nothing is installed and nothing signs in. The [developer workbook *Building Non-Person Identity*, Chapter 09](../../../docs/project-plans/developer-workbooks/non-person-identity/09-ai-agent-identities.md) links Learn rather than quoting the pages.

**How it stays honest.**

- `snapshot.json` records the upstream repository, paths, commit, dates, licenses, each file's git blob hash (checked against the upstream tree at that commit before the manifest was written) and the size and SHA-256 of every file here. `scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py` fails if any file is changed, added or removed.
- The weekly source watch follows commits to each upstream page (`npi-agent-create-blueprint-page-commits`, `npi-agent-inheritable-permissions-page-commits` and `npi-agent-disable-page-commits` in `data/source-watch/feeds.json`) and reports each one in its issue under DW (developer workbooks).
- To move to a newer upstream commit: review the upstream change, copy the pages from that commit, regenerate `snapshot.json`, rerun `examples/non-person-identity/tests/NpiAgentId.Tests.ps1` and the Chapter 09 labs, and open a pull request. Never edit the files here; changes the program needs go in `examples/non-person-identity`.

These files keep their upstream bytes, line endings included, so the hashes match the upstream commit.
